title: Another phd bites the dust
author: Mistry Originals
intro_narrative: The summer term has left NUS eerily hollow. Detective Lin Meiying arrives at SOC3 after campus security reports what looks like a fourth-floor fall. The lobby is quiet, the air-conditioning hums, and everyone wants a simple story. Lin’s job is to keep it from becoming one—until the evidence earns it.

required_motive: Desperation to obtain qualifying-exam materials; theft attempt escalated to murder when caught.

phases.name: Arrival & Scene Control
phases.objective: Secure the immediate area and determine whether the death is truly an accident.

phases.name: Alibis & Access
phases.objective: Check suspects’ opportunity: who could enter, and who can be placed elsewhere during the time of death.

phases.name: The Rope Trail
phases.objective: Trace the murder weapon and verify who could source it and bring it upstairs unnoticed.

phases.name: Synthesis & Confrontation
phases.objective: Connect method, access, and motive into a single narrative and force a break in the culprit’s story.

NUS SOC3 Building lobby.description: Sunlight pools across polished tiles. The lobby feels abandoned—just a vending machine blinking and the soft hiss of air-conditioning. Anyone entering SOC3 must pass through here, whether they want to be remembered or not.
clues: The lobby is unusually empty and quiet for a weekday morning, suggesting few witnesses and making electronic access records unusually important.

visual_metadata.setting: A bright, echoing university lobby with minimal foot traffic; every sound carries.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Near the center by the doors

Prof Aishik's office (SOC3, 4th floor).description: A cramped office packed with posters, journals, and a desk squeezed between a bookshelf and a filing cabinet. The door is ajar. A toppled chair and scattered papers frame Prof Aishik’s body on the carpet. The window latch is clicked tight—too tidy for a supposed fall.
clues: A rope burn and bruising around Prof Aishik’s neck indicate strangulation, not a fall.
A short length of thin rope is found coiled behind the office bookshelf, with frayed fibers matching neck abrasions.
Prof Aishik’s keyboard has clear, fresh fingerprints that do not match the victim’s usual touch points but match Taha Aksu.
The office window is shut and dustless, inconsistent with a staged ‘fall’ or open-window struggle.
A torn corner of a printed qualifying-exam rubric is wedged under the desk caster near the victim’s shoe.
A faint smear of printer toner on the office desk edge matches fresh handling of printed documents.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Behind the second row of journals, reachable by sliding books aside

SOC3 4th-floor corridor.description: A sterile corridor with a faint disinfectant sting, as if someone tried to clean the story before you arrived. The water cooler sits untouched. Doors are quiet and closed, but the building feels like it’s listening.
clues: Kuluhan Binici’s keys cannot open Prof Aishik’s inner office door; Taha’s access card can.
Taha gives an overly specific account about ‘finding the professor after he slipped,’ before the cause of death is announced.

visual_metadata.setting: A bright but lifeless academic hallway; the cleanliness reads as deliberate rather than routine.

Graduate lab room (SOC3, 3rd floor).description: The lab smells of solder and instant noodles. A fan clicks in the corner. Workbenches are lined with half-built prototypes, and a whiteboard screams deadlines. Yeet’s posture is rigid—defiance and fear in equal measure.
clues: Yeet’s lab door camera log shows Yeet badging into the lab during the likely time of death.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Center of room under fluorescent lights

Cleaning room (SOC3, basement).description: A damp, detergent-heavy room of buckets, brooms, gloves, and trash bags. The floor is always a little wet. Everything is inventoried—except, apparently, the things someone wanted not to be noticed.
clues: The cleaning-room inventory shows a missing length of utility rope used for bundling trash bags.

visual_metadata.setting: Service-space utilitarian and damp; the kind of room people enter only when they think no one is watching.

connections.mechanism: Service corridor door to stairwell access

objects.hidden_by: A roll of trash bags and folded gloves

Stairwell between basement and 4th floor.description: Concrete steps and cool air. Each landing is a blind spot between worlds: lobby, lab, office, and basement. Footsteps echo long enough to feel like a second presence.
clues: The stairwell’s echoing, low-traffic route provides a discreet path between the basement cleaning supplies and the fourth-floor offices without passing the main lobby.

visual_metadata.setting: A utilitarian vertical corridor: stark concrete, fluorescent buzz, and perfect opportunities for unseen movement.

Campus security post near SOC3.description: A small security booth with sign-in sheets, monitors, and a tired fan pushing warm air. This is where stories become records: timestamps, access, and who wants to be officially remembered.
clues: Access-card logs show only one non-faculty entry to the fourth-floor area during the window: Taha Aksu at 07:03.

Detective Lin Meiying.persona: Calm, precise, and patient; asks narrow questions and lets silence do work.

knowledge_about_others.Officer Goh: Capable but prone to accept the easiest narrative until evidence forces a shift.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Aksu: Ambitious; talks like someone pre-writing a defense.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Openly resentful of budget cuts, but willing to provide logs.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Defensive and gruff; more concerned with being blamed than with the victim.

Detective Lin Meiying.abilities: Can summarize evidence chains, unlock deductions when multiple clues are collected, and trigger suspect confrontations in Phase 4.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Lin delivers a structured accusation tying rope source, office access, and keyboard prints into a single timeline, forcing the suspect to respond.

Yeet.role: Graduate student with a public dispute (budget cut) and a strong paper trail alibi.
Yeet.persona: Blunt, tired, and defensive; speaks in clipped sentences and pushes receipts (logs) over emotion.

knowledge_about_others.Taha Aksu: New; 'too polished' for an empty campus day.
knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Ran qualifying exams and kept rubrics/notes; students get desperate.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Siti Rahman: Knows departmental processes; would know who should access what.

Yeet.secret: They exaggerated how heated the budget argument was, fearing it would paint them as violent.

Kuluhan Binici.role: Cleaning staff; controls supply access but lacks office authorization.
Kuluhan Binici.persona: Grumpy, literal, and quick to feel accused; answers with irritation but knows his inventories.

knowledge_about_others.Officer Goh: Came by earlier asking about supplies and keys.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Aksu: Has seen students tailgate into service areas; cannot always identify which ones.

Kuluhan Binici.secret: He sometimes leaves the cleaning-room door propped during rounds, making tailgating easier than he admits.

Dr. Siti Rahman.role: Faculty colleague; provides procedural context and confirms exam-material sensitivity.
Dr. Siti Rahman.persona: Professional and careful; speaks in measured, policy-aware language.

knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Kept qualifying-exam rubrics and annotations; was strict about confidentiality.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Aksu: New PhD; requested 'forms' unusually early and seemed anxious about qualifying timelines.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Had budget disputes but is generally transparent and trackable in the lab.

Dr. Siti Rahman.abilities: Can corroborate motives around qualifying-exam materials and explain access norms (who should have office entry).

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Siti confirms the rubric appears recently printed and sensitive, strengthening theft-as-motive rather than personal revenge.

Officer Goh.role: Campus security officer; gatekeeper for records and initial response.
Officer Goh.persona: Subdued and pragmatic; wants resolution but follows Lin’s lead when evidence contradicts first impressions.

knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Has access to service areas; has been blamed before.
knowledge_about_others.Taha Aksu: Registered in the access system; his card permissions are unusually broad for a new student.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Known to be outspoken; lab systems keep decent logs.

Officer Goh.abilities: Can retrieve access-card logs, verify key/door access, and authenticate camera logs.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Goh confirms the access timeline and identifies the only relevant non-faculty entry during the window.

Taha Aksu.role: New PhD student; primary suspect with access and behavioral slip.
Taha Aksu.persona: Polished, controlled, and overly explanatory; when pressed, slips into rehearsed specifics and then silence.

knowledge_about_others.Prof Aishik: Had qualifying materials and could report misconduct.
knowledge_about_others.Yeet: Had a known argument with the professor—useful as a decoy narrative.
knowledge_about_others.Kuluhan Binici: Cleaning supplies exist; basement is accessible if one tailgates.

Taha Aksu.secret: He entered the office to search for qualifying-exam materials; when caught, he panicked and used a thin utility rope to silence the professor.

required_knowledge: Taha gave the 'slipped' story before cause of death was announced
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Taha’s composure cracks; he shifts from denial to a panicked admission about being caught searching for exam materials.
